applies_to: Lennox rooftop units with the IMC (M1-7, v5.02 or later) unit controller and the IMC BACnet module.
summary: The IMC BACnet module mounts on the older Lennox IMC (M1-7) rooftop controller and translates its SysBus data to BACnet MS/TP at a fixed 38.4 kbps. The BMS can act as a zone sensor (setpoint plus space temperature) or as a thermostat (application mode stage commands). It exposes 64 analog and binary objects (two printed ranges are shown as one row each); COV is not supported.
notes: AI 244 is named 'Outdoor Air Damper' on its per-object page; the summary table (Table 6) calls it 'Outside Air Damper'.

AI 274-277: the summary table lists only Space CO2 Sensor (Local) at AI 274 and Space Humidity (Local) at AI 276, while the per-object pages put the effective values at 274/276 and the local values at 275/277. The per-object pages are followed here.

The document prints IMC Version[00]..[07] (AI 200-207) and Most Recent Error 1..10 (AI 255-264) only as patterns; each is listed here as one row at its first instance. The other instances exist but their names are not printed individually.
AO 102, 127 and 128 hand control back to the IMC when written with 101-255.
Stage commands 224-236 on AO 101 only work when the IMC is set for remote thermostat operation.
Alarm code meanings are in the IMC user guide, not this document.

integration.summary: Address each IMC with its DIP switch (1-31), then either send a zone setpoint (AO 109) and space temperature (AO 113) with occupancy, or send thermostat-style commands on Application Mode Control (AO 101). Keep those values refreshed inside 5 minutes. Read Unit Status, Space Temperature and Current Error for monitoring.

minimum_points.name: Application Mode Control
minimum_points.why: Mode: 0 auto, 1 heat, 3 cool, 6 off (more codes)

minimum_points.name: Space Temperature Input
minimum_points.why: Zone temp from the BMS in BACnet sensor mode

minimum_points.name: Unit Status
minimum_points.why: Operating mode: heat, cool, off, fan only and more

integration.enable: The IMC must be set locally (ECTO 6.01 / 5.27) for BACnet thermostat or BACnet zone sensor control. Occupancy is the OR of Occupancy Scheduler Control, Occupancy Override Control and Occupancy Sensor Input; no input can force unoccupied. Jumper TB1-8 to 9 so the unit runs occupied backup setpoints if the module link fails.
integration.heartbeat: Application Mode Control (AO 101, thermostat mode) and Space Temperature Input (AO 113, BACnet sensor mode) must be rewritten within 5 minutes or the IMC goes to its backup mode; Lennox recommends updating them at least every 2 minutes.
integration.remote_sensors: With a BACnet zone sensor, write the space temperature to AO 113 and the setpoint to AO 109 (plus offset AO 110). The IMC derives occupied heat/cool setpoints from the single setpoint and the ECTO 6.15 deadband (default 3 °F). When updates stop it falls back to ECTO backup setpoints and a Lennox zone sensor or the return air sensor.
setup: BACnet MS/TP at a fixed 38.4 kbps; up to 31 modules per network.
MAC and device ID come from the IMC unit address DIP switch, 1-31 (do not use 0).
Every module has the device name 'Lennox'; it cannot be changed.
Terminate only the last module with the supplied 120 ohm resistor.
gotchas: COV is not supported; poll the values.
After power-up the unit stays off up to 5 minutes until the BMS sends a setpoint and sensor value or a thermostat command.
Writing 101-255 to AO 102, 127 or 128 returns that value to local IMC control.
Unit Status 145-177 are heat pump defrost states, not faults.

points.description: IMC communicating with the BACnet module

points.name: Application Mode Control
points.states: 0 = Auto, 1 = Heat, 3 = Cool, 6 = Off, 9 = Fan only, 208 = Fan auto, 209 = Fan on, 216 = Exhaust auto, 217 = Exhaust on, 218 = Exhaust off, 224-236 = remote thermostat stage commands, 254 = Reset, 255 = Null

points.name: Occupancy Override Control
points.states: 0 = Occupied, 1 = Unoccupied (not supported, auto), 2 = Refresh override timer, 3-255 = Auto

points.name: Occupancy Sensor Input
points.description: Occupancy sensor value from the network

points.name: Space Temperature Input
points.description: Zone temperature from a BACnet sensor

points.name: Emergency Override Control
points.states: 0 = Normal, 1 = Pressurize, 2 = Depressurize (speed), 3 = Purge (speed), 4 = Shutdown, 5 = Fire, 6 = Depressurize (pressure), 7 = Purge (pressure), >7 = Normal

points.name: Supply Fan Capacity Input
points.description: Supply fan speed, % of max; 101-255 = local

points.name: Exhaust Fan Capacity Input
points.description: Exhaust fan speed, % of max; 101-255 = local

points.name: IMC Version[00], IMC Version[01], ..., IMC Version[07]
points.description: IMC firmware version characters (null-terminated ASCII); AI 200-207

points.name: Unit ID
points.states: 48-63 = Gas heat/electric cool, 64-79 = Electric/electric, 80-95 = Heat pump

points.name: Unit Status
points.states: 1 = Heat, 2 = Morning warmup, 3 = Cool, 5 = Pre-cool, 6 = Off, 7 = Test, 8 = Emergency heat, 9 = Fan only, 12 = Max heat, 14 = Dehumidification, 129 = Fresh air heating, 131 = Fresh air cooling, 145 = Defrost comp 1, 161 = Defrost comp 2, 177 = Defrost comp 1 & 2

points.name: Local Outside Air Temperature
points.description: Outdoor air temperature from IMC sensor

points.name: Economizer Enabled
points.description: Outdoor air suitable for free cooling

points.states: 0 = Not installed, 1 = Installed, not running, 2 = Running
